cities.name: Myrtle Beach
cities.localNotes: Myrtle Beach's median single-family sale price was about $525,000 in 2025 (Coastal Carolinas Association of REALTORS data reported by MyHorryNews). Coastal buyers should budget for flood and wind insurance, which lenders may require and which affect the monthly payment.

cities.name: Conway
cities.localNotes: Conway's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $312,000, making it one of the more affordable places in Horry County to buy.

cities.name: Carolina Forest
cities.localNotes: Carolina Forest's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $445,000. Much of the housing is newer construction.

cities.name: North Myrtle Beach
cities.localNotes: North Myrtle Beach's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $560,000. Many buyers here purchase second homes, which are financed and taxed differently from a primary residence (Horry County assesses primary homes at 4% and second homes at 6%).

cities.name: Surfside Beach
cities.localNotes: Surfside Beach's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $410,000, up from about $395,000 in 2024.

cities.name: Little River
cities.localNotes: Little River's 2025 median single-family sale price was about $355,000, slightly lower than in 2024.
